The chloral hydrate, a sedative, was identified as a significant contributing factor in her death. Toxicology reports revealed the presence of multiple additional drugs, including several benzodiazepines and other sedatives. Investigators emphasized that no single drug alone caused her death, but rather the cumulative effect of the drug combination.
